tests: Verify layout containment of dirty warning notice and 'Enregistrer le brouillon d’abord' button at desktop 1168x774 with 308px sidebar, confirming inspector width does not exceed ~350px and does not overlap the preview canvas.
Verify 'Enregistrer le brouillon d’abord' button text wraps onto multiple lines cleanly with h-auto and whitespace-normal without clipping text or hiding the Save icon (shrink-0).
Verify the video unavailable warning card correctly constrains its flex child with min-w-0 and max-w-full without expanding rightwards.
Verify pending AI request snapshot card and instruction mismatch alert constrain text with min-w-0, flex-1, and break-words, preserving the 'Abandonner' button visibility and clickability.
Verify long error messages, retry URLs, and AI notices wrap within bounds via min-w-0 and break-words without shifting inspector layout into preview.
Verify that existing accessibility roles (role="status", role="alert"), onClick handlers (save, handleAbandonPendingAiRequest), and disabled states remain unchanged.
